scripts.copyfiles:basic: copyfiles -f src/sound-capture/index.html build/sound-capture && copyfiles -f src/sound-capture/PCMStream.worklet.js build/sound-capture
scripts.copyfiles:prod: npm run copyfiles:basic && copyfiles -f .prod.env build && npx yshx mv build/.prod.env build/.env
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ..
scripts.compile:dev: tsc && npm run copyfiles:dev && npm run build:frontend
scripts.compile:prod: tsc && npm run copyfiles:prod && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start: tsc && npm run copyfiles:dev && electron build/index.js
scripts.start:frontend: cd frontend && npm run start && cd ..
